content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to receive serial data via an RS485 port/module on a [product_name]? I am trying to monitor communication (RS485 half duplex) between an industrial door controller and a motor encoder. The door controller sends a 2-byte request, and the encoder responds with a telegram of 2 or 3 bytes. There is no established protocol—just simple telegram exchange. I saw that you could do this with a [product_name] using a serial module ([article_no]) and a freeport configuration, but since I need the display and buttons of the [product_name], I’d like to know if this setup could work. I have not found any modules like [article_no] for [product_name], or any solutions here or online. Thanks in advance,
[product_name] only supports Ethernet TCP/IP using the [protocol_name] or Modbus TCP/IP. It has one ethernet port and lacks a communication module for serial RS485 connection.
Understood, thank you for the information and quick reply. Wishing you a good day.
Wishing you a great day as well ...
[product_name] cannot interface with Modbus RTU RS485 but can connect via MODBUS TCP. To make it work with RS485, a Modbus RTU/TCP converter or server is required.

Since late 2021, [product_name] CIM has been available, which is a compact converter that enables [product_name] to work with Modbus RTU RS-485 or RS-232. Quick overview: [protocol_name] support, modem functionality, 4-port switch. It replaces much of what previous communication modules offered. The current version is v1.1.

analysis.insight_summary: The primary concern discussed is the lack of RS485 serial communication support in older versions of the [product_name] module. This limited users who wished to monitor RS485 communication between devices. While another controller supports this feature with a serial module ([article_no]), the [product_name] did not offer comparable hardware at the time. The later release of the [product_name] CIM module addressed this gap by adding RS485 capability, changing how the product could be used in similar applications.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking the ability to receive and monitor RS485 serial data directly with the [product_name], preferably through built-in support or a compatible module, similar to solutions available with other controllers.
